{{< video videos/backbone_morph.mp4 >}}

The contact-guided backbone morph from calmodulin (1CLL) to troponin C (1NCX) is the
     other morph example. Until `Morph To Attribute` exists, the two structures are shown one
     after the other by keying the objects' render visibility, and the target turns to finish.

After ProteinMotion's [`backbone_morph.py`](https://github.com/pdpppd/proteinmotion/blob/main/examples/backbone_morph.py).

## Script

Run it with `uv run python docs/examples/timeline/scripts/backbone_morph.py out_dir`; set
`MN_EXAMPLES_QUICK=1` for a small, fast check. The script is included from the file:

```{.python filename="scripts/backbone_morph.py"}
{{< include scripts/backbone_morph.py >}}
```
